steps.reason: Scope the dataset to the last 30 days of transactions before running any detection logic.
Compute per-account rolling features — especially the % of transactions near the $10,000 threshold and velocity metrics — which are required inputs for the rules engine to detect structuring.
Apply the structuring rule, which flags accounts with multiple transactions just below the $10,000 reporting threshold within the time window.
Assign LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH risk levels to accounts flagged by the structuring rule so analysts can prioritize review.
